description: Header file defining the DoorBell class and its nested Connector class, including methods for ringing, acknowledging, waiting, and handling doorbell signals, with socket communication and event handling.

classes.name: DoorBell
classes.description: Represents a doorbell mechanism with methods to ring, acknowledge, wait, and handle incoming signals.

classes.name: DoorBell::Connector
classes.description: Handles socket communication for the DoorBell, including binding, unbinding, ringing, and reading socket data.

methods.name: DoorBell::Ring
methods.description: Triggers the doorbell ring signal and sets the event.

methods.name: DoorBell::Wait
methods.description: Waits for the doorbell event with a specified timeout.

methods.name: DoorBell::Ringing
methods.description: Sets the internal signal to indicate ringing.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::Ring
methods.description: Sends a ring message via socket.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::Read
methods.description: Reads incoming socket data and triggers ringing if a doorbell signal is detected.
